source: segmentation (Blender render with background replaced by white)
units: pixels (x right, y down, full-resolution image coordinates) and seconds; no metric scale recorded

camera.evidence: phase correlation of the static upper scene between consecutive frames: max |dx| 0.20 px, max |dy| 0.06 px
camera.perspective: side-on view of a row of furniture; 2D scene, cat walks in a plane parallel to the image; cat apparent size constant (bbox length 277-323 px, height 198-227 px, mask area 19.3k-23.2k px, no trend)

cat.description: black cat with grey/tan lower legs and paws and a grey muzzle; walks left to right along the floor in front of the bench and the TV stand; the only moving object
cat.occluded: never (it is in front of all furniture); never touches image edges
cat.recommended_reference_point: dark_cx, dark_cy (centroid of the black body columns: torso+head, no tail/legs) or cx, cy (centroid of the full mask); both move ~17.7 px/frame horizontally with little vertical drift

size_px.body_length_note: columns with >= 35 px of black fur: rump to head, excludes tail and thin legs
